title: Bhubaneswar U-19 Event Now World Junior Championships Selection

summary: The Haryana U-19 Ranking Tournament has been postponed, and the Bhubaneswar U-19 Ranking Tournament is now designated as the selection event for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
